description: A single-storey side and rear extension creating a larger kitchen and living area in Great Leighs, Chelmsford.

caseStudy.text: The Paynes asked Architecture ONE for more space at The Gables, Banters Lane, Great Leighs, Chelmsford.
caseStudy.heading: The Brief

caseStudy.text: The design added a single-storey side and rear extension, creating a larger kitchen and living area.
caseStudy.heading: The Approach

caseStudy.text: Chelmsford City Council granted full planning permission for the extension in August 2018 (application ref. 18/01184/FUL). A later phase of work (see '15 Julia Payne') carried the approved scheme through to construction-ready drawings.
